intent: CUSTOM COLOR SCALE FIGHTING THE THEME via an %%{init}%% themeVariables block that sets primaryColor, primaryTextColor AND nodeTextColor all to #ffffff - i.e. the user explicitly asks for white text on a white fill (1.00:1), the exact pathology wave 1 measured in quadrantChart/journey. It also pins background/mainBkg to #ffffff so the diagram should keep a LIGHT background inside a dark page - the 'hardcoded-light-background' failure the brief names. Tests whether the init directive overrides the theme, is overridden BY it, or is merged inconsistently; and whether the enhancer's contrast-remediation pass (wave 1's COLOR-PARSE-FAIL) catches a 1.00:1 pair it can actually parse, since every value here is a clean hex.
